name: victor-codex-skills
description: Codex-native variants of Victor Blaga's Claude workflow skills. The Claude skills remain canonical.

interface.shortDescription: Codex-native workflow skills derived from canonical Claude prompts
interface.longDescription: Install Victor Blaga's workflow skills for Codex, including project-aware workstream implementation from JIRA to PR, copy-paste-ready goal prompt generation, deep implementation, multi-dimensional review, review triage, architecture planning, structural refactoring, whole-codebase cleanup sweeps, codebase cross-examination, long-form writing support, design-quality frontend review of implemented UI surfaces, post-implementation decision audits with fresh-context cross-checks, conversational bottom-up Fermi TAM analysis for growth stocks, and long-horizon FCFF DCF anchored to those TAM outputs.
defaultPrompt: Run a deep implementation workflow from a proposal or review report
Use workstream-implementer to take a JIRA ticket through repo scope, implementation, PRs, and review
Generate a /goal prompt for a ticket-backed implementation loop
Do a mega-review and then triage the findings into a plan
Design a refactor top-down and then implement it in Codex
